name: comp-507
title: Date Range Preset Picker
blurb: Date range picker with preset shortcuts for common ranges.
description: Selects a start and end date using a calendar in range mode. Preset buttons set common ranges (Today, Last 7 days, Month to date, etc). Only past dates are available.
use_when: Filtering data by date range where users benefit from quick presets like 'Last 30 days' or 'Year to date'.
avoid_when: When only single dates are needed, or when future dates must be selectable.
a11y: Keyboard navigation through calendar and presets. aria-live announces range selections.
